description: Retrieve only metadata for a blob without downloading content. Useful for checking properties.
embedding_description: Get file info without downloading. Check blob properties. Inspect file metadata. View file size type date. Get attachment details. Check stored file info. Examine file attributes. Query file properties.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Blob metadata without content: blob_id, namespace, size, content_type, created_at, updated_at, and user-defined metadata key-value pairs
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves blob metadata without downloading the actual content
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: blob_id does not exist in the specified namespace. AccessError: namespace access denied. StorageError: blob storage service unavailable.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found errors: verify blob_id or use search_blobs to find correct ID. For access errors: check namespace permissions. For storage errors: retry or check service status.
